title: RetailOps Export Mapping
description: Mapping between CoreProduct fields and RetailOps CSV columns for Nike men's footwear. Column names and order are sourced from the RetailOps CSV Field Mapping Notion spec.

columns.description: Ordered array of column mappings. Order determines CSV column order.

source.description: Dot-path into CoreProduct (e.g., 'sku', 'styleCode', 'images.0.url'). Empty string if no direct mapping.

required.description: Whether this column is required in the export

default.description: Default value when source is missing or empty

transform.description: Name of transform function to apply (e.g., 'uppercase', 'formatDate', 'joinImages')

columns.name: Product Name
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct doesn't have a title field. Build from brand + class + colorPrimary. See Notion row.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct doesn't have a description field. Leave empty or populate from meta.description if available.

columns.name: Size
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct represents a style, not a size-specific SKU. Size not available at product level. See Notion row.

columns.name: Cost
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct doesn't have a cost field. Requires inventory/procurement data.

columns.name: Currency
columns.description: Currency code. Defaults to USD for MVP.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct doesn't have inventory quantity. Requires inventory data.

columns.name: Warehouse
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct doesn't have warehouse info. Requires inventory data.

columns.name: First Received
columns.description: TODO: CoreProduct doesn't have first received date. Requires inventory data.

columns.name: Launch Date
columns.description: Product launch date in ISO 8601 format

columns.name: Primary Image
columns.description: Primary/hero image URL (first image or isPrimary=true)
